license_model: Apache 2.0 Graphiti OSS + Zep commercial cloud
primary_use_cases: Temporal knowledge graph memory for agents; enterprise chat with fact validity; LongMemEval and DMR leader
deployment_options: Zep Cloud; self-host Graphiti; graph backends Neo4j, FalkorDB, Kuzu, Amazon Neptune
pricing_summary: Commercial Zep tiers; Graphiti OSS free
integration_model: Zep SDK/API; Graphiti library for temporal KG ingest and search — framework adapters, not LLM interceptor
storage_backends: Temporal knowledge graph + embeddings; multiple graph DB backends
memory_tiers: Episodes, facts, entities; bi-temporal fact validity; graph-derived context blocks for LLM
graph_model: Temporal KG: entities, relationships, valid_from, valid_to, invalid_at; multi-hop traversal; conflict via invalidation not delete
extraction_approach: LLM entity and edge extraction into Graphiti; episode ingestion from messages
update_operations: Invalidate outdated facts; add new edges; temporal supersession
consolidation_strategy: Graph maintenance and fact invalidation pipelines; semantic compression over episodes
temporal_model: First-class: valid_from, valid_to, invalid_at; enables 'what was true at time T' queries
agent_fact_handling: Episodes include assistant messages; facts extracted from full dialogue
retrieval_signals: Graph traversal + semantic search on facts and episodes; hybrid context assembly
reranking: Relevance scoring on graph paths and embeddings
latency_profile: Paper: <200ms retrieval; 90% latency reduction vs baselines on enterprise tasks
token_efficiency: Targeted fact bundles vs full history
multimodal_support: Primarily text episodes; platform may expand
user_profiles: User entity nodes and fact collections
framework_integrations: LangChain, LangGraph adapters; compared in Mem0 paper as dedicated memory platform
locomo_scores: Included in Mem0 paper comparisons; Zep strong on temporal categories
longmemeval_scores: Paper reports 71.2% on LongMemEval (Zep temporal KG paper marketing)
benchmark_methodology: DMR benchmark 94.8% claimed; LongMemEval; academic paper arXiv:2501.13956
stated_unsolved_problems: Operational complexity of graph DBs; cost of continuous graph updates at scale
known_limitations: No zero-code interceptor; heavier infra than SQL-only; learning curve for temporal model
memorable_has: TemporalMemory helper metadata; consolidation contradiction handling (simpler)
memorable_lacks: Bi-temporal validity columns, graph DB production backend, episode→fact extraction pipeline, DMR-class scores
memorable_should_port: valid_from/valid_to/invalidated_at schema; soft-invalid facts; episodic rollup to semantic facts (C2)
memorable_should_skip: Rebuilding full Graphiti — adopt temporal patterns in SQL + optional Neo4j
